_comment: DRAFT 2026-10-12 (wave 4), from Florist Farms' untrusted listings. Most untrusted listings pointed at the right product with the pack size (10pk 100mg gummies, 7pk 3.5g vs 5pk 2.5g pre-rolls, 1g AIOs and carts) or the line (Non-Infused vs Live Resin Infused singles) read below 0.9; those are handled by reading examples (data/reading_examples.json 'florist-farms'). This plan holds only what the catalog lacked: the 2-piece gummy packs stores sell beside the site's 10-packs. Curated entries survive storefront re-pushes. Not written: apply with --write after approval.
